title: Prop bible
description: bibles/props.json (optional): one description string per prop that is held or featured, compiled verbatim wherever a card holds or features it, with its prop sheet as refs.

name.description: The name cards use in holding and holding_end, e.g. tin matchbox.

description.description: Material, size against a hand, shape, color, wear. One article, no emblems unless the story needs them.

refs.description: Prop sheet image ids: hero three-quarter first, then other angles and a detail, the prop alone on grey; sent with every shot that holds or features the prop.

states.description: Other looks of the same object (open, broken, burning, empty). A card picks one with holding_state or props[].state.

description.description: The whole look in this state, not a diff: restate material, size and color.

refs.description: Images of this state; replace the prop's refs for that shot.
